searchStringsArray.title: Search queries
searchStringsArray.description: One business search per line, ideally in 'keyword in city' format (e.g. 'dentists in Austin TX'). Each query is scraped independently. Google Maps caps one query at ~120 results - split large areas into narrower queries. Aliases accepted via API: searchQueries, queries.

placeUrls.title: Direct place URLs (optional)
placeUrls.description: Google Maps place URLs to scrape directly, skipping the search step. Useful for re-runs of failed leads.

maxResults.title: Max results per query
maxResults.description: Maximum number of places to scrape per search query (Google hard-caps a single query at ~120). Aliases: maxPlacesPerQuery, maxCrawledPlacesPerSearch.

includePlaceDetails.title: Open each place (phone, website, hours)
includePlaceDetails.description: Visit every place's detail page to extract phone, website and opening hours. Disable for a 3-5x faster, cheaper run with feed data only. Alias: scrapeDetails.
includePlaceDetails.sectionDescription: Control what is scraped and how fast.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel browser pages. Keep low (1-5) to avoid blocks; higher values increase proxy usage without proportional speedup.

language.title: Language
language.description: Google Maps interface language code (hl parameter), e.g. 'en', 'de', 'es'.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: RESIDENTIAL proxies are strongly recommended - Google blocks datacenter IPs almost instantly. Consider setting a proxy country matching the searched location.
